entities.summary: Robert Thomas "R. T." Moore was an American businessman, ornithologist, philanthropist, and founder and editor-in-chief of the Borestone Mountain Poetry Awards. In his obituary, Lionel Stevenson wrote, "Robert Thomas Moore was an exceptional amalgam of the poet, the scientist, and the man of affairs."
